children: The Turkish central bank said on Thursday it had decided to temporarily suspend one-week repo auctions conducted as part of its open market operations.

It also said in a statement it had decided to raise the remuneration rate applied to required reserves maintained for lira deposits to 90% from 86% of the bank's weighted average funding cost to support macro financial stability and the monetary transmission mechanism.
